proposals.expected_signal: Higher frozen full-sort NDCG@10 from reduced popularity-dominated message reuse, with strongest gains on mid-tail items.
proposals.failure_mode: If dropout suppresses too many high-confidence user-item links, propagation becomes under-connected and ranking quality falls across all item groups.
proposals.hypothesis: Applying degree-aware stochastic edge removal during training should reduce hub-node oversmoothing in light graph propagation, forcing embeddings to rely on more discriminative collaborative paths.

proposals.expected_signal: Small but reliable NDCG@10 lift if embedding norm collapse is currently limiting item discrimination near the top of the list.
proposals.failure_mode: If the geometry penalty over-constrains the factor space, user-specific ranking flexibility shrinks and head-item ordering worsens.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding an explicit geometry regularizer that separates user and item norm statistics while discouraging anisotropic factor collapse should improve top-rank discrimination without changing the retrieval protocol.

proposals.expected_signal: Improved NDCG@10 if intermediate graph layers contain complementary preference signals that are currently unstable or misaligned.
proposals.failure_mode: If the auxiliary contrastive term dominates ranking supervision, representations may become uniformly smooth across layers and hurt personalization.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a residual multi-layer encoder with an auxiliary contrastive objective aligning adjacent-layer user-item representations should preserve useful depth-specific signals while stabilizing transformed message passing.

proposals.expected_signal: NDCG@10 gain from down-weighting ambiguous training pairs, especially if noisy sampled negatives currently distort the top of the ranking.
proposals.failure_mode: If the weighting heuristic misidentifies informative hard negatives as uncertain, learning becomes too conservative and pairwise separation weakens.
proposals.hypothesis: Replacing uniform pair contribution with constraint-weighted pairwise updates based on prediction uncertainty should focus light graph training on reliable ranking constraints and reduce harmful gradient noise from false negatives.
